title: Excellent Room Humidifier
text: Excellent Room Humidifier. I would have given this unit 5-stars if not for the fact that the one I received had a defective guage. If you prefer a top fill, then this unit is not for you, as it's fill is located on the bottom. Amazon very kindly accepted it back, as defective after I order another unit that was slightly bigger. The replacement from the same manufacturer is functioning perfectly.
